title: Find every element of a kind with FilteredElementCollector: by category, by class, in a view, by parameter value
task: Collect elements with FilteredElementCollector: all walls by BuiltInCategory (OfCategory + WhereElementIsNotElementType), all instances of a class (OfClass), elements visible in one view (the view-scoped collector), and elements whose parameter equals a value (ElementParameterFilter with FilterStringRule); return ids and counts, never elements. The script first creates three scratch walls to collect.

miss.surfaced: Wall members and BuiltInCategory entries; the collector chain is not a member

pitfalls.symptom: search_functions cannot answer 'get all walls': the collector idiom is a chain of calls, not one member.
pitfalls.cause: FilteredElementCollector is a builder; the answer is OfCategory/OfClass + WhereElementIsNotElementType, which no single search hit shows.
pitfalls.fix: Use the chain in step 1 or 2 of this script.

pitfalls.symptom: A category count is higher than the number of elements on screen.
pitfalls.cause: OfCategory alone also returns the element TYPES of that category.
pitfalls.fix: Add WhereElementIsNotElementType() (or WhereElementIsElementType() when types are what you want).

pitfalls.symptom: OfClass(typeof(Room)) throws: 'is of an element type that exists in the API, but not in Revit's native object model'.
pitfalls.cause: Room has no native class to filter on.
pitfalls.fix: Collect rooms with OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Rooms), or OfClass(typeof(SpatialElement)).
